'''Excuse me?'''}} # {{n-g|Said as a request for an individual's attention.}} # {{n-g|Said as a request to pass somebody.}} #: {{ux|en|'''Excuse me''': can I get through please?}} # [[sorry|Sorry]], {{n-g|as an apology.}} # {{lb|en|formal}} {{n-g|Said as an expression of unexpected or early farewell.}} #: {{usex|en|Oh, '''excuse me''', I hadn't realized how late it was.
